annotations.text: AGWeb, browser-first. Top-left: pure browsing — zero dev chrome, just a Deck button. Right: two directions for how the Dev Deck appears. A (Stage): the page scales back into a spotlit stage and blocks dock around it. B (Overlay): glass blocks float over the page. The bottom-left artboard is interactive — click its Deck button to play the reveal/hide animation (Direction A choreography).
Interactive: click the Deck button (top right of the artboard) to toggle the reveal. Stage retreats, blocks slide in staggered; click again to hide.
